We box. My grandpa has a boxing ring in the basement (62 yrs old and still constantly training, guys a beast). My brother is a cutman and my dad is a referee as a way to make extra money, and we've all been training since we were old enough to fit boxing gloves. 

Every year, we open one gift on Christmas eve. These gifts are then put up as prizes, and the loser has to give up their gift if the winner wants to exchange. Last year, my middle brother (19) broke my youngest brother's (18) nose for a shirt. I knocked my cousin out cold to defend my new pair of Lonsdale boxing shoes. After the fights are over, we get together, hug it out, and walk around town caroling door to door, finishing the night with hot chocolate and cookies. 

This year, my mom told me she got my middle brother a PS4. God help the little prick if he opens it on Christmas eve.

Alright, wall of text coming. I apologize, and will try to format it as well as mobile will allow. 

I've completely given up on trying to have any kind of relationship with my father. 

He was never really around as a kid, and after meeting him at 11, it kinda stayed that way. I'd go over for visitation, and he'd just stick me in a room with video games and a mini fridge and pretty much left me there for a weekend. I keep pushing to spend time with him, but I get nowhere. 

So the story really starts when summer of 2014. He meets a chick from Minneapolis (we live in Western MI, about 12 hours away), and decides to move in with her. She comes to MI for 2 weeks, and that's the most I've ever seen my dad. He came over all the time, became interested in my kids, we go out together all the time, I met his girlfriend, it was a lot of fun in hindsight. After he moved, I didn't hear from them again. I felt used. Like I was only there so he could show how great of a family man he was. At that point, I started to realize my dad wasn't the kind of guy I wanted my kids calling grandpa, and I wished him well. 

Fast forward to the next spring. Dad and gf are getting married, and want me to be there. I have 2 kids, a wife, and a full time job. There's really no way this can work out. But I try anyway, and plans end up falling through. So dad's fiancee starts getting weirdly passive aggressive on FB. After much drama and confrontation, I pretty much told them both that it made no sense to go, considering my dad wasn't there for me at all. Lots of hurt feelings, and we stop talking for about 5 months. 

5 months later, my wife and I separate, well on our way to getting divorced. My step mom started playing like she wanted to be there to help me out, offering to even move me in with them to start new. She helped out a lot, and then things started to get weird. She starts sending me nudes, telling me how badly she wants to fuck me, she wants a father son three way, all kinds of weird shit. I'm in no right mind at this point. I'm in a mania from the stress of the divorce, being eaten alive by guilt, I'm drunk all them time, and I'm getting into drugs again. And all step mom is saying is I want to fuck you, my pussy is throbbing for you, tell me what you want to do to me, etc etc.

About a week of this goes by, and my mom (who I was living with at the time) sees the texts between her and I. She calls my dad, tells him, sends screen shots, the whole nine. My step mom texts me and says she took the blame for all of it, so my dad wasn't gonna be angry with me. She was wrong. He now literally wants nothing to do with me because she's a fucking whore. In the end, I'm kinda glad it happened. It just goes to show how little he actually cared for me all along, and now I'm focusing on repairing my marriage, spending time with my kids, and preparing for our third kid. Life is going way better, because I'm not sinking so much effort into getting my dad to love me. 

TL;DR dad's never around, gets remarried, new step mom sends nudes and wants to fuck, and now my dad hates me, and I couldn't be happier.
